Exact seller gallery images were visually inspected: no SOLD/RESERVED/DEPOSIT TAKEN/UNDER OFFER overlay was visible and the cabin clearly shows a conventional manual gear lever. However, Baker Brothers' current used-car inventory says 54 cars are available and does not list this 993.
